task.name: pick_plate_from_drawer_put_pink_cube_ep1
task.description: Use the right arm to place the pink block on the drawer onto the table, and use the left arm to place the blue block onto the pink block.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the pink block on the drawer.
2. Grasp the pink block with the right arm.
3. Move the right arm to align with the table.
4. Release the gripper to place the pink block onto the table.
5. Move the left arm to approach and align with the blue block.
6. Grasp the blue block with the left arm.
7. Move the left arm to align with the pink block.
8. Release the gripper to place the blue block onto the pink block.
